budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-XG successor (LEAD2-S81/SLICE 10-19, after s81sl_xg gate2 GRT stalled 4 h in congestion at 12 % std util): rstop RELAY=1 (every rstop output leaves through a relay register: no single-cycle wire across the 648-um tile; line/V payload reset-free, valid bits reset only) + xs RD2=1 (24-macro read crossbar -> bank-local 8:1 registered beside each bank column + 3:1 bank stage; long read wires 24x1536 -> 3x1536). +1 edge on rstop outputs, +1 on xw_d. Prior: S81-XG (10-19): new hardened gather sub-leaf of the S81 slice centre (C1 / C3 master child u_xg, 16 per die): ring stop data plane ot_s81sl_rstop (tier line E/W 1,104 b, V rung 276 b, NX snake ends, sid = 2*col + tier decode from S81-LBGAP G2 1b7c4b828) + x streamer ot_s81sl_xs (kit s81sl_xs floorplan v2 of 1dcaa1b20, never routed). The rstop -> xs gather port (3 x 1,031 b a cycle) stays internal. Floorplan: per-source x-buffer bank columns facing their ring faces (bank 1 = from W at x 86.4, bank 0 = own / V at 216, bank 2 = from E at 432), the 7 ROMs abutted in one column at 345.6 between bank 0 and bank 2 (calendar / phase / stream control in the middle), std-cell ring around the macros for the face pin-flop bands; clock + reset at the S-face centre. Same RTL cycles as the slice benches; reset landed at the face (2 stages, ROOT-RST). Gate1 (10-19, ot-agidock128) died at macro placement: the ROOT-RST landing-only wrapper (pin_regs off + reset_landing on) renames the core u_ot_pr_core, so the spec's u_s.* instance names matched nothing -> instance patterns are globs '*u_s.g_bank?b?.g_mac?m?.u_mem' / '*u_s.u_<rom>' (match with or without the wrapper). Variant xgr2: outline 734.4 x 604.8 (+22 % routing area, faces <= 5.2 pins/um), macros shifted +43.2 in x.
